name: atlassian
title_zh: Jira 工单与 Confluence 页面共用一个
tagline_zh: 不用切窗口，在对话里搜 JQL 查工单、写 CQL 翻 wiki，改状态、留评论、建页面全搞定。
tagline_en: Stop tab-hopping: search Jira with JQL, browse Confluence with CQL, update statuses, comment, and create.
desc_en: Manage Jira issues and Confluence wiki pages in Atlassian Cloud. Use when: (1) searching/creating/updating Jira issues with JQL, (2) searching/reading/creating Confluence pages with CQL, (3) managing Jira workflows, transitions, and comments, (4) browsing Confluence spaces and page hierarchies. Supports OAuth 2.1 via MCP server (recommended) or API token authentication (fallback).
why_zh: 把两套系统的查询语法揉进同一段对话，省去来回切换的上下文断裂。
why_en: Merges JQL and CQL into one conversational flow, saving context-switching. OAuth 2.1 via MCP beats static tokens for enterprise.
limit_zh: 只认 Atlassian Cloud，不支持 Server/Data Center。
limit_en: Atlassian Cloud only (no Server/DC). Requires admin-enabled OAuth or your own API token. No attachments, dashboards, or permission config; workflow.
title_en: One chat to manage Jira issues and Confluence pages
